checks: mova-modelcheck groupants structural validation after parent registration
cost: Symbolic linear catalog scans, O(C+reached*L) BFS and bounded-length greedy expression lookup; no timing measurement.
description: Query compiled seed catalogs with lexical senses, link paths, judgments and bounded expression matching.
forward: Exact catalog queries preserve table-order policies; sense ties choose the earliest maximum.
BFS and bounded first-edge consequences are distinct traversals.
Expression matching uses greedy lengths and lemma-priority forms merge.
inverse: Scoped U minus R models exclude noncatalog choices and invalid traversal/selection outputs.
Preimage models retain ambiguous texts, candidates, ignored fields and build-data uncertainty.
limitations: Compiled seed catalog only; not the fully implemented durable global graph.
AST unmaterialized; generated OUT_DIR source and data dependencies are not bound by the lib.rs hash.
Optional expression/idiom tests may return early; prospective oracles unexecuted.
Twelve root models and four nested fragments with four models each are declarations, not proofs.
state: Fixed compiled tables, first hot snapshot, lazy expression/register indexes and typed query inputs.
